title: Simple Carpentry
description: Better way to work with wood
body:
![Sawmill with cordwood around](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9aa1f5c685009cf7614602d3e28b8f0c113f514_0.webp)

A mod that allows you to work with wood much more better.

Info found in the wikidoc below
[Wikidoc](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GZgxtKkmG6ghzg7xEQIboH8KTuSbbys1ARthdQyZ1J8/edit?usp=sharing)

This mod adds a sawmill along with a bunch of new building blocks!
